name: brainstorming

summary.en: Part of Jesse Vincent’s Superpowers set: turns a rough idea into a design through one-question-at-a-time dialogue before any implementation starts.
summary.zh: Jesse Vincent 的 Superpowers 套件之一：在动手实现之前，通过一次只问一个问题的对话，把模糊想法变成设计方案。

upstreamDescription: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).
